brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit form with multiple shelf/storage levels
requirements.evidence: 4 full bases across levels 0-1 plus bins at q -1,1 0,0,-1 0,0,0 1 providing shelf surfaces on two storeys

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books (load rating)
requirements.evidence: Configurator checks fit/collision only; parts are 3D-printed plastic with no load rating. Build provides bins/surfaces for books as staging but cannot be claimed as 50 kg rated
drawer:0#-1,-1#cut and drawer:1#2,-1#cut on half-s bases

finish.summary: Built multi-level shelf unit (levels 0 & 1, full bases + bins) with two drawers on half-s bases. Added sample book prop. 50kg load rating cannot be verified or claimed for 3D-printed plastic as configurator only checks geometry.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
